name: aamako-agro
description: Cross-platform development launcher for Aamako-Agro (Backend API + Admin Dashboard + Storefront)

scripts.setup: npm --prefix Backend install && npm --prefix Frontend install && npx --yes pnpm@9 --dir Dashboard install
scripts.db:setup: npm --prefix Backend run db:push && npm --prefix Backend run seed
scripts.build: npm --prefix Backend run build && npm --prefix Dashboard run build
